decision.topology: Use a compact common plenum with direct front twin-port throttle flange and six runners fanning outward at both ends. Actual Ford drawings and the specimen photograph agree; no long front feed duct is added.
decision.dimension_class: All coordinates are explicit estimates, not calibrated photo measurements or factory specifications. Existing cylinder/lower flange interfaces are preserved as project datums.
decision.owner_landmark_inference: Cap X300 leaves approximately67 mm between its center and cover front X367: about one69.09 mm comparison cap diameter. Front plenum X200 sits100 mm behind cap center: about1.45 comparison diameters. These are plausible rough owner-photo proportions, not measured distances.
decision.lateral_height_inference: Retain Y25/Z490 provisionally: owner photographs show plenum laterally offset from cap and elevated above cover, but cannot uniquely resolve lateral/height coordinates. These are audited for coherence, not declared verified.
decision.why_not_previous_trial: Anchoring rear X-367 solely to preserve the old EGR interface produced little rear fan-out and conflicted with both-end runner splay visible in the specimen. Rear EGR/EVP now moves with the shortened plenum; fixed-end tubing must be rerouted explicitly.
decision.cap_shape: Ford-photo-consistent pilot cap proportions and assumed4.5 mm pitch remain unchanged; only cap/neck station changes. Original cover opening is regenerated closed before the new one is cut. No separate plug or second fill hole is represented.
remaining_source_limits: Exact production datum coordinates and runner centerlines unknown
Top stiffening ribs and casting boss detail not yet represented
Different specimen/service-year comparisons do not establish all1994 casting revisions
Production neck construction and thread dimensions remain unknown
decision.egr_height_inference: Ford exploded comparison places diaphragm housing above plenum. Raise existing valve datum25 mm: diaphragm plane544 versus plenum roof535; outlet center514 remains inside cavity449–531. Source-consistent estimate permits compact fixed-end tube routing; not a factory dimension.
decision.retention_kernel_regression: Native translated cap/neck Boolean falsely returns zero straight-pull overlap at X300. STEP world-coordinate roundtrip restores149.912 mm³. All final exact checks therefore bake posed solids and verify bounds/volume/validity. The regression is evidence about the CAD kernel, not permission to alter the interface.
